DGFT Issues Trade Notice 07 on PAN Validation Services

Last updated: 25 Sep 2026

S
Samjho Content Team
Finance and policy experts with 5+ years of experience helping Indians understand money, documents and government schemes.

Quick Summary

The Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) has released a trade notice about PAN validation services. The notice is numbered 07 and comes from the Ministry of Commerce & Industry. The full details sit in the linked official PDF, so importers and exporters should read it directly.

Why It Matters

What Happened

The Directorate General of Foreign Trade has put out a trade notice on PAN validation services. It is called Trade Notice 07. The DGFT works under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry.

The official update is shared as a PDF document. The short public note only points readers to that document.

What Changes

The notice deals with how PAN validation services work for trade-related processes. PAN validation means checking your Permanent Account Number against official records before it is accepted.

The exact rule changes are listed inside the trade notice PDF. This short summary does not cover them, so do not assume anything before you read the full notice.

What You Need to Do

Open the official trade notice PDF linked in this article. Read it fully if you file DGFT applications or handle import-export paperwork.

If your PAN details do not match your other documents, fix them early. Mismatched details can slow down or block your applications.

Share the notice with your customs broker, chartered accountant, or compliance team. They handle these filings for you.

Deadline

Not specified in the official source. Check the trade notice PDF for any effective date or last date.

FAQs

What is this trade notice about?

It is about PAN validation services. The DGFT released it as Trade Notice 07.

Who issued this notice?

The Directorate General of Foreign Trade, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, issued it.
